records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 18% to $118.1 million in the three months ended September 30, 2021 from $100.1 million in the three months ended September 30, 2020.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 61% of our revenue during each of the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021, respectively, as compared to 63% and 64% in the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
records.text: Software license revenue represented 4% of our revenue during each of the three and nine months ended September 30, 2021, as compared to 6% for the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
records.text: While the additional import duties have resulted in an increase to our cost of hardware revenue, these import duties had a modest impact on hardware revenue margins.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2021
records.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2021, cash flows from operating activities were $83.2 million, compared to $66.7 million for the same period in the prior year.
